# references

dpi-h-ra's bibliography: one folio-reference/v1 CSL-JSON entry per cited work, `<key>.json`. The paper cites them by key (`\cite{key}` in a block's text, and `cites` on its manifest), each citation links to its entry on the KG Bibliography page (`en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/#ref-<key>`), and the [References](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#reference) chapter's list is generated from them by `references:render`. Footnotes are kept only for notes that explain rather than cite.
